sections.title: Who we are and how to reach us
sections.text: CimessFruit sells fruit and smoothies in Abesan Estate, Lagos. For privacy questions or account help, email cimessthemanofvalor@gmail.com or call 08089273565.

sections.title: Information we use
sections.text: We use your name, email, phone number, account credentials, delivery address and any saved map coordinates to manage your account and deliver orders. We keep order and payment-review records and messages you send to support. Google sign-in, when used, supplies your basic profile and verified email. Passwords are stored as hashes.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Location permission is requested when you use your current location and, on Android, when looking up an address for a selected map pin. You can enter your address manually if you decline. We save the coordinates only when you confirm a delivery pin. We do not use background location tracking.

sections.title: Service providers and delivery
sections.text: The store and delivery personnel use your delivery details to fulfil orders. Hosting and database services process application data; Resend handles account emails; Cloudinary hosts product photos. Google or Apple map services process map and address lookups. We do not ask you to send bank passwords, card PINs or login credentials in support messages.

sections.title: Retention and account disabling
sections.text: You can disable your account through the Disable account page. Disabling ends your sessions and prevents sign-in. Your profile, orders, payment and refund records, and support history remain linked to your account for continuity and store accounting. Existing orders and financial obligations remain in place. You can request a secure reactivation link from sign-in or signup to restore access to the same account. Backup copies expire according to the store’s backup schedule; contact support for retention questions.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can update your profile, change location permissions in device settings, request account disabling, or contact support about access or correction of your data. We use session storage to keep you signed in and local cart storage to remember your basket.

sections.title: Ordering
sections.text: CimessFruit sells the products and sizes shown in the live catalogue. Prices are in Nigerian naira. Checkout checks stock, calculates the delivery fee and saves the payable amount. Availability can change before you complete an order.

sections.title: Payment
sections.text: Pay only using the bank details shown for your saved order. Selecting “I have paid” requests a payment review; it does not confirm receipt. The store checks its bank account before marking payment verified and preparing your order. Do not transfer twice if your status has not updated; contact support with your order reference.

sections.title: Delivery and account details
sections.text: Provide an accurate delivery address, phone number and useful entrance or landmark details. Check any automatically suggested address before confirming. Delivery is available only in the active zones shown at checkout, and delivery times are estimates.

sections.title: Questions and problems
sections.text: Contact support in the app or email cimessthemanofvalor@gmail.com about an order, payment or product issue. Our refund and delivery pages explain the current ordering process. These terms do not remove applicable consumer rights.

sections.title: Before payment
sections.text: You can cancel an unpaid order from its order page. Unreported unpaid orders expire after 24 hours and their reserved stock is released by scheduled maintenance.

sections.title: After transferring
sections.text: If you have sent money, report the transfer on the order and contact support before cancelling or paying again. Transfers under review require store verification. Rejecting a payment in the admin system does not automatically return money.

sections.title: Wrong, damaged or missing products
sections.text: Contact the store promptly with your order reference and details of the problem. Keep photos where useful. The store will review the issue and agree the appropriate resolution with you. Do not include passwords or bank PINs in your message.

sections.title: Refund handling
sections.text: After the store approves a return or dispute resolution, its approved value becomes return credit that you can use on another order. Credit used toward an unpaid replacement order is reserved until that order is paid or cancelled. Only the amount and goods approved by the store become credit; opening a complaint does not start a timer. Approval starts a 20-minute buying window with Buy again selected by default. You can use that approved amount or order a replacement during the window. Any unused balance goes to a manual bank refund after the window, even if you selected credit or replacement. This does not promise bank-transfer completion within 20 minutes. The store locks the refund amount before making the manual transfer. Locked amounts cannot be spent. Delivery fees are refunded only when explicitly approved. Support will confirm the amount and transfer timing. Contact cimessthemanofvalor@gmail.com or use Support in the app.

sections.title: Coverage and charges
sections.text: Available delivery zones, fees and estimated times are shown at checkout. A map pin is checked against configured delivery boundaries. If your address is outside an active zone, contact support before paying.

sections.title: Finding your entrance
sections.text: Confirm the street, house number or entrance, phone number and nearest bus stop or landmark. The rider can use your saved coordinates and written directions. Suggested map addresses may be incomplete; please correct them before ordering.

sections.title: Order progress
sections.text: The store verifies a reported bank transfer, prepares the order, then marks it dispatched and delivered. Open your order page to check updates. Estimated delivery times are not a guaranteed arrival time.

sections.title: Delivery help
sections.text: If the location is difficult to find or your delivery is delayed, contact support with your order reference. Do not change your saved profile expecting an existing order to change: orders retain the delivery details confirmed at checkout.
